RVNL Secures Rs 903 Crore Contract from SJVN for Bihar Power Plant

Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) has secured a contract worth Rs 903 crore from SJVN Thermal Private Limited. The contract is for the construction of a 1,320 MW thermal power plant in Bihar. Following the announcement, RVNL shares saw a 2% increase on the stock market. The order pertains to the SJVN Thermal project.
